question: Should OpenClaw retire the documented staging/private environment-key injection path now and require configured feed verification as the sole signed-feed trust mechanism?
rationale: The merged foundation deliberately included the environment override during a staged signing rollout, while this PR removes it before the production trust root is bundled; the intended operator and trust-boundary contract needs explicit owner confirmation.

options.title: Approve config-only trust injection
options.body: Confirm configured feed verification is the complete supported replacement for staging and private deployments, then merge the removal.

options.title: Keep the staged override temporarily
options.body: Retain the environment path until maintainers define and prove the production key handoff and activation transition.

recommendation.title: Approve config-only trust injection
recommendation.body: Confirm configured feed verification is the complete supported replacement for staging and private deployments, then merge the removal.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged signed-feed trust work is the concrete prior contract this PR narrows.
